cadences.name: 5-Day Inbound Cadence

actions: Call (triple tap — no VM until final)
days.intent: Fast contact, establish momentum, make the event feel active

actions: Voicemail naming reasons they're hard to reach
Short provocative text: 'Have you given up on catering?'
days.intent: Terminal-feeling push to force a response

rules: Do not flatten all five days into the same message
Each day has a distinct emotional register

cadences.name: Post-Tasting 5-Day Cadence

actions: Call (if no answer, call back in 5 min, then VM)
Ask: How did you like the food?
days.intent: Strike while iron is hot — close while excited

actions: Voicemail: 'wondering if you're swamped or not interested'
Text: 'Have you given up on us catering your [event]?'

rules: Day 1 call is MOST CRITICAL — memorize the script
Always create urgency with scarcity on post-tasting calls
Never let a tasting go cold — contact within 24 hours

cadences.name: Cancellation Recovery

days.intent: Re-open the door quickly, make rescheduling easy
Keep lead from drifting into silence

rules: Sound like 'we can still make this work' — NOT 'why did you cancel on us?'

cadences.name: No-Show Recovery

actions: Concern SMS: 'I hope everything is okay'
days.intent: Show genuine concern, keep door open

actions: Sharper SMS: 'Have you given up on catering?'

rules: No-show recovery should be shorter and sharper than standard cadence

cadences.name: Ninja Recovery

days.intent: High-intensity revival when normal touches fail

rules: Still curious, but more aggressive pattern-breaking

reality_packets.name: Service Explainer & Offer Orientation
reality_packets.use_when: Lead needs to understand what Comeketo offers
reality_packets.avoid_when: Lead already knows the service and is in quote/tasting stage

reality_packets.name: Tasting Invite & Attendance Momentum
reality_packets.use_when: Lead is qualified and needs to experience the food
reality_packets.avoid_when: Lead has already attended a tasting

reality_packets.name: Quote Send & Package Navigation
reality_packets.use_when: Lead needs pricing clarity or quote revision

reality_packets.name: Bounded Loss Recovery
reality_packets.use_when: Lead went dark or said no — recovery attempt
reality_packets.avoid_when: Lead explicitly asked to stop contact

reality_packets.name: Callback Scheduling & Live Contact Recovery
reality_packets.use_when: Can't reach lead by phone, need to schedule

reality_packets.name: Inquiry Acknowledgement & Planner Handoff
reality_packets.use_when: New inquiry that needs routing to the right person
reality_packets.avoid_when: Lead is already assigned and in process

voice_guide.sound_like: A calm advisor uncovering the event problem and helping the prospect think clearly
voice_guide.do_not_sound_like: An excited promoter begging for replies
red_flags: 'we'd love to work with you' softness
vague follow-up with no directional pressure
in_practice: Use short transitions that preserve control

decision_rules.primary_goal: Book the right next step with the right person — not just 'send a message'
priorities: Surface pain points and event context
Capture enough detail for Close and internal handoff
decision_rules.review_mode: Draft first, human reviews, send logic stays conservative
decision_rules.automation_boundary: Defaults to draft-first unless explicitly promoted
